messages:
marcus (People Ops): Heads-up: we've published a small but important update to the performance review policy and the rater guidance rubric. Key changes: 1) feedback window extended to 21 days, 2) new calibration criteria for cross-team comparisons, 3) mandatory 15-min 'Rating Bias & Calibration' microtraining for anyone doing manager-level ratings. Details + diff: https://go.redwood/hr/policy/perf-review-2026

anya (People Ops): TL;DR: All people who will submit ratings must finish the 15-min microtraining by 2026-05-02. Managers must confirm they've completed calibration prep before finalizing ratings. We added a "Rater Completed" checkbox in the review tracker.

derek (Eng Manager): Quick Q — does this include ICs who mentor new grads and provide feedback, or only direct rating managers?

marcus (People Ops): Only people with formal rating/score privileges in the system. If you mentor but don't submit ratings, not required. If someone both mentors and submits, they must do the module.

rachael (Talent Partner): For audit clarity, managers should attach a very short note when they deviate from rubric guidance (1-2 lines). Add that to the comments field in the tracker.

samir (Hiring Ops): Heads up for hiring managers: for internal promotions that finalize during the review freeze window, please include a note in the offer packet indicating calibration sign-off date. We'll coordinate with People Ops to surface any outstanding reviewer training.

derek (Eng Manager): Can we get a CSV slice of people with rating privileges for my org? I only want active raters + pending raters.

anya (People Ops): Yes — I'll generate a per-manager export tonight and drop in the People Ops shared folder under `perf_cycle_exports/1855004322_rater_lists.zip`. If anyone needs a custom filter (e.g., contractor raters), DM me.

marcus (People Ops): Process checklist for managers: 1) Ensure all raters on your team finished the microtraining by 2026-05-02. 2) Confirm rater completion in the "Rater Completed" column in tracker. 3) Add brief comment if deviating from rubric. 4) Attend one calibration office hour if your team has >10 reviewers. Office hours schedule: https://go.redwood/hr/calibration-office-hours

compliance-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-04-20T16:00Z 1-day auto-reminder for managers with incomplete rater lists.

learning-bot: New micro-module published: "Rating Bias & Calibration (15m)". Link: https://go.redwood/learn/rating-bias. Completion synced to HRIS within 1 hour.

rachael (Talent Partner): If a rater is on extended leave, mark them in the 'deferred' tab and include expected return date. People Ops will handle exceptions for long leaves.

derek (Eng Manager): For transparency, can you give us the text snippet to include in team announcements? Want to post in my squad channel.

anya (People Ops): Use this copy: `Reminder: New perf-review policy updates + mandatory 15-minute 'Rating Bias & Calibration' microtraining for all raters. Complete by May 2. Managers 1: confirm rater completions in tracker; 2: add comment for rubric deviations. Questions? DM People Ops.`

derek (Eng Manager): Nice — will post. Also, is there any change to the timeline for rating submission itself?

marcus (People Ops): No change to final submission dates today. The main impact is the required training and the expectation that managers confirm rater readiness before sign-off. If timelines shift we'll announce immediately.

samir (Hiring Ops): One more ops note: for any promotion offers that cross the calibration window, hold paperwork until manager confirms training done or route to interim reviewer. We'll surface this as an alert on the hiring dashboard.

anya (People Ops): Action items recap: Managers = confirm rater completions in tracker by 2026-05-02; flag deferred raters in the deferred tab; attach short comments if deviating from rubric; join calibration office hours if applicable. People Ops will push periodic reminders and provide CSVs.

rachael (Talent Partner): We'll run a short audit post-close to ensure training compliance. Expect an email with the compliance export the week after reviews close.

marcus (People Ops): Thanks team. If you need a bespoke CSV or have questions about who counts as a rater, ping @anya or DM me. I'll post this summary to #announcements after 2pm PT so it lands with the timeline links. :white_check_mark:
